summary: CKGSB's global marketing team is juggling a critical Outlook account lockout, the upcoming CKGSB-IE report launch, and a strategic pivot to prioritize China-based programs like Asia Start and Intelligent China.
summaryDetail: The most urgent issue this week is resolving the Outlook account lockout across all devices—everyone must delete and re-add their accounts with the new password and confirm with JSB that the backend lock is lifted. In parallel, the CKGSB-IE report (now titled 'CKGSB-IE University Report Reveals New Models for Chinese Companies Going Global') is entering final production: the webpage, press release, and one-page flyer must be finalized, with social promotion and index sharing (BCI/BSI) to follow. The knowledge website redesign is also moving forward: Joseph will share the HTML file, and the team will meet to mark specific feedback before Joker implements changes, including incorporating BCI/BSI indices and removing the video section. Longer-term, the team is executing a strategic shift to prioritize China-based programs (Asia Start and Intelligent China) for SEO and marketing, with a focus on AI, EVs, and smart manufacturing, while US partnerships are on hold except for Berkeley as a third priority. Additionally, the Tech in Asia Conference requires approval for two extra guests and a progress email to Zongchao, and the August 2026 Business Conditions Index needs to be shared with the network.
